To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the threshold voltage shift of parasitic LOCOSTM field transistors depends on the substrate doping level and is dominated by the substrate current.

the LOCOS isolation structure is a critical component in determining the total dose tolerance of the parasitic field transistor, and that the total dose tolerance can be improved by reducing the LOCOS isolation width and increasing the substrate doping level.
the isolation breakdown is dominated by the parasitic LOCOS transistors and the total dose tolerance of the LOCOS isolation is strongly dependent on the substrate doping level.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the total dose effects on the isolation of MOSFETs.
the total dose tolerance of the parasitic LOCOS isolation field transistors.
the total dose tolerance of MOSFETs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a LOCOS isolation structure is not a reliable structure to be used in a total dose environment.
a higher substrate doping level results in a better total dose tolerance of the parasitic LOCOS MOSFET.
the total dose tolerance of the LOCOS isolation structure can be improved through the optimization of the process parameters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the total dose tolerance of the parasitic LOCOS MOSFETs is improved by reducing the isolation oxide thickness and increasing the substrate doping.
the LOCOS isolation is not as sensitive to total dose effects as previously thought.
the total dose tolerance of MOSFETs is improved by increasing the substrate doping concentration and by decreasing the LOCOS oxide thickness.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a low doping level of the substrate is beneficial to improve the total dose tolerance of the parasitic LOCOS transistors.
the parasitic transistors are not affected by the ionizing effects as long as the substrate is heavily doped.
a low substrate doping level (less than 1016 cm−3) is necessary for the LOCOS field transistor to be radiation tolerant.
